tasks.label: Build frontend with quoted path
tasks.command: Set-Location -LiteralPath 'C:\Desktop\Jeffmenzo Auto  & Business Ventures'; npm run build

tasks.label: Build frontend from resolved workspace
tasks.command: $project = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Desktop' -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'Jeffmenzo Auto*Business Ventures' } | Select-Object -First 1; Set-Location -LiteralPath $project.FullName; npm run build

tasks.label: Build frontend directly with Node
tasks.command: $project = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Desktop' -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'Jeffmenzo Auto*Business Ventures' } | Select-Object -First 1; Set-Location -LiteralPath $project.FullName; node .\node_modules\vite\bin\vite.js build

tasks.label: Install API dependencies
tasks.command: $project = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Desktop' -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'Jeffmenzo Auto*Business Ventures' } | Select-Object -First 1; Set-Location -LiteralPath (Join-Path $project.FullName 'server'); npm install

tasks.label: Start Jeffmenzo frontend
tasks.command: $project = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Desktop' -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'Jeffmenzo Auto*Business Ventures' } | Select-Object -First 1; Set-Location -LiteralPath $project.FullName; node .\node_modules\vite\bin\vite.js --host 127.0.0.1

tasks.label: Check API JavaScript syntax
tasks.command: $project = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Desktop' -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'Jeffmenzo Auto*Business Ventures' } | Select-Object -First 1; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $project.FullName 'server\src') -Recurse -Filter *.js | ForEach-Object { node --check $_.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; Write-Output 'All API JavaScript files passed node --check.'

tasks.label: Rebuild frontend
tasks.command: $project = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Desktop' -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'Jeffmenzo Auto*Business Ventures' } | Select-Object -First 1; Set-Location -LiteralPath $project.FullName; node .\node_modules\vite\bin\vite.js build

tasks.label: Install API packages through Node
tasks.command: $project = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Desktop' -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'Jeffmenzo Auto*Business Ventures' } | Select-Object -First 1; Set-Location -LiteralPath (Join-Path $project.FullName 'server'); $nodeDir = Split-Path (Get-Command node).Source; node (Join-Path $nodeDir 'node_modules\npm\bin\npm-cli.js') install
